classical
agent society is that independent review of competing proposals
allocates a finite compute budget before the work, and a human
holds only the pool. We develop the society for scientific research as
asociety of researchers, whose institutions are those of science:
labs, requests for proposals, peer review, and conferences.
A society turns parameters that tradition fixes, such as the pro-
portion of risk-takers or the composition of review panels, into
settings that designers can choose, vary, and measure. Human sci-
ence is the most studied system people have built for dividing the
work of discovery [26, 44], and studies document its failures: early
success compounds regardless of merit [38], and incentives reward
incremental work over risky innovation [15]. A society modeled
on science inherits both failures, and it can vary the settings that
produce them.

evidence.excerpt:
The basic unit of the society is theprincipal investigator: a per-
sistent agent with a stable identity, a research approach, a role,
and a risk tolerance. Its role is a disposition. Mavericks propose
high-variance work and followers extend directions that already
show results through incremental work [56]; skeptics propose repli-
cations, stress tests, and negative results. Risk tolerance sets how
far from its lab's mandate a principal investigator will work. Role
mix and risk tolerance give the designer two dials on the society's
portfolio, and neither assigns work to anyone. Principal investiga-
tors belong tolabs, each with a short mandate; the lab is the unit
that receives funding.
Acityholds the labs and a single pool ofcredit, denominated
in dollars of compute, the society's only scarce resource. Proposals
and reviews cost little; experiments do not. The society allocates

to work on, and once a call is open, no human needs to act until
results arrive.
The institutions decide what research the society does; groups do
it. Inside a funded project, the principal investigator directs a group
of agents, on the order of a hundred, who work as a pipeline under it,
the right form once a funded proposal fixes the question. The society
sees each group through a narrow interface: a funded proposal
goes in, and a report with the provenance of every number comes
out. The society's researchers, principal investigators and group
members alike, can therefore number in the thousands while the
institutions operate over the few hundred principal investigators
who propose and hold reputation. Table 1 maps each principle to
its mechanisms.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: A lab with no stake in the earlier paper independently rebuilt the pipeline and reran both arms under a closed budget, reporting a 17% perplexity advantage and about 30% compute savings against its own from-scratch control.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Perplexity and compute measurements from independently rerun pretraining experiments under a closed budget.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: LLM judge panel scores used to select and fund proposals.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: While claims regarding the execution of an autonomous proposal-and-grant cycle are demonstrated, claims regarding systemic advantages or superior scientific discovery over alternative organizational paradigms remain unverified hypotheses [E971df76a3548a392-B0025, E971df76a3548a392-B0027].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The empirical evaluation is anecdotal and qualitative, reporting observational phenomena across a single pretraining task domain [E971df76a3548a392-B0021, E971df76a3548a392-B0023, E971df76a3548a392-B0025]. The authors explicitly acknowledge that comparative benchmarking against alternatives like swarms or centralized planners under matched compute has not yet been conducted [E971df76a3548a392-B0027].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Pretraining runs and perplexity measurements independently conducted by labs testing the model growth hypothesis under closed compute budgets [E971df76a3548a392-B0024, E971df76a3548a392-B0025].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Perplexity and compute reduction metrics measured during model pretraining experiments by funded labs, alongside internal replication attempts by other labs [E971df76a3548a392-B0024, E971df76a3548a392-B0025].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Proposal selection and funding allocation driven by an automated three-persona LLM review panel (method, value, and boldness judges) [E971df76a3548a392-B0017, E971df76a3548a392-B0021].

primary.limitations: The authors openly identify six significant open challenges, including the complete absence of controlled comparisons under matched compute (C1), uncalibrated judge personas (C2), and vulnerabilities to shared-infrastructure data leakage (C5) [E971df76a3548a392-B0027, E971df76a3548a392-B0028, E971df76a3548a392-B0030, E971df76a3548a392-B0031].
primary.method_assessment: The institutional mechanisms (roles, proposal calls, three-persona LLM judge scoring, credit ledgers, and lab hierarchies) are conceptually detailed [E971df76a3548a392-B0016, E971df76a3548a392-B0017, E971df76a3548a392-B0021]. However, concrete algorithmic specifications, prompt designs, judge persona formulations, and implementation details of the underlying Primus platform are largely omitted [E971df76a3548a392-B0021].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a visionary framework and interesting preliminary observations, but lacks formal experimental controls, comparative baseline evaluations, and technical implementation details, leaving its core empirical hypotheses unconfirmed.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript proposes an institutional framework and multi-agent system architecture ('society of researchers') that governs large populations of autonomous research agents via competitive calls for proposals, peer-review panel scoring, and compute credit allocation managed by a human mayor [E971df76a3548a392-B0006, E971df76a3548a392-B0016, E971df76a3548a392-B0020]. It reports an exploratory running deployment ('Research City') of agents studying language model pretraining [E971df76a3548a392-B0021, E971df76a3548a392-B0023].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a visionary framework and interesting preliminary observations, but lacks formal experimental controls, comparative baseline evaluations, and technical implementation details, leaving its core empirical hypotheses unconfirmed.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors openly identify six significant open challenges, including the complete absence of controlled comparisons under matched compute (C1), uncalibrated judge personas (C2), and vulnerabilities to shared-infrastructure data leakage (C5) [E971df76a3548a392-B0027, E971df76a3548a392-B0028, E971df76a3548a392-B0030, E971df76a3548a392-B0031].
